bottleneck: Feature generation (~180s) + event proxy computation (76 symbols x bar-level flags) + portfolio simulation + random permutations. Feature gen alone consumes 60% of budget.
proposed_fix: Pre-cache features + event flags in Phase 10. Phase 11.5 portfolio runs read cached data. Reduce first-pass permutations to 250 with early-stopping if clearly pass/fail.
confidence_impact: LOWER_CONFIDENCE_BASELINE if 250 perms used. Full 500-1000 recommended for final gate.
